label: SIMULATED BENCHMARK: demo world DEMO-1, scripted operator (reviews with simulator ground truth after 3.0s) and scripted responder (acknowledges after 2.0s). Measures system latencies and counts, not human performance or real-video detection.

metrics.computed_from: incident event log and stored records

localization_error.source: simulator ground truth, matched by image box overlap (evaluation only)

sources.observations: observations_raw table (every observation is also an `observation` event)
sources.candidates: person observations and their latest `review` events
sources.detection_to_review: observation received_at to its first `review` event
sources.confirmation_to_alert: first confirming `review` event to the first `alert` citing the observation
sources.localization_error: observation world position against simulator ground truth (simulated only)
